title: Show a surprise
instructions: Decide how the two ideas are linked, then choose the word.

parts.prompt: The path looked dry, ___ the ground under the leaves was still soft.

choice_rationales.A: Looking dry does not explain why the ground was soft.
choice_rationales.B: Unless would set a condition, and no condition is described.
choice_rationales.C: But shows the surprise: the path looked dry, yet the ground was soft.
choice_rationales.D: So would make the soft ground a result of the path looking dry.

parts.hint: Would you expect soft ground on a path that looks dry?
parts.correct_explanation: The second idea is not what the first idea leads you to expect, so a contrast word fits.
